m: Fries: oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into thin fries, toss with oil, salt and chopped rosemary, roast 35 to 40 minutes, turning once.
Caramelised onion: slice thin and cook low in oil for 20 minutes until jammy, adding the sugar at the end.
Burger sauce: mayo, tomato sauce, mustard and chopped pickles.
Roll the wagyu into 100g balls. Smash flat on a smoking hot plate, season hard, cook 2 minutes until a deep crust forms.
Flip, add cheese, cook 1 minute. Stack two per burger.
Toast the brioche. Sauce, lettuce, patties, onion, pickles. Fries on the side.
l: Patties and onion over shredded lettuce with sauce on the side. Skip the bun.
g: GF buns, and cook the GF patties first on a clean surface. Check the mustard and pickles.
